role.en: Professor, Tsinghua University; Chief Scientist & Co-founder, Z.ai (Zhipu AI)
role.zh: 清华大学教授；智谱 Z.ai 首席科学家兼联合创始人

why.en: Academic architect of the GLM line. ChatGLM was the first Chinese open large model to build a real developer ecosystem — and the company he founded became the first foundation-model business anywhere to list publicly.
why.zh: GLM 系列模型的学术总设计师。ChatGLM 是中国最早形成开发者生态的开源大模型 —— 他创立的公司也成为全球首家以通用基础模型为主业的上市公司。

title.en: 'The Wave Has Arrived' — letter to Zhipu staff
title.zh: 《浪潮已至》—— 致智谱全员信

note.en: Frames the listing not as a finish line but as a reset: return fully to foundational model research and invest in the next generation of AGI-oriented systems.
note.zh: 把上市定义为重启而非终点：完全回到基础模型研究，投入下一代面向 AGI 的系统。

title.en: Two weeks. That's how long it took to go from GLM-5.3-Flash's first run on domestic accelerators to serving all of its production traffic, with 3.2× end-to-end
title.zh: Two weeks. That's how long it took to go from GLM-5.3-Flash's first run on domestic accelerators to serving all of its production traffic, with 3.2× end-to-end

note.en: Tang Jie says it took two weeks to move GLM-5.3-Flash from its first run on domestic accelerators to serving all production traffic, with a 3.2x end-to-end throughput gain.
note.zh: 唐杰表示，GLM-5.3-Flash从在国产加速器上首次运行到承担全部生产流量仅用两周，端到端吞吐量提升3.2倍。

title.en: AI的下一站，是AI自我进化、自己创造自己的继任者。这被称为RSI，递归自我改进。最近在GLM的研发过程中，我们已经看到了这种能力的早期迹象：GLM-5.3开始帮助优...
title.zh: AI的下一站，是AI自我进化、自己创造自己的继任者。这被称为RSI，递归自我改进。最近在GLM的研发过程中，我们已经看到了这种能力的早期迹象：GLM-5.3开始帮助优...

note.en: On his verified Weibo, Tang Jie describes early signs of recursive self-improvement in GLM development: an infra agent powered by GLM-5.3 helped optimize GLM-5.3-Flash's deployment on domestic chips, roughly tripling throughput in two weeks.
note.zh: 唐杰在其认证微博上介绍了GLM研发中出现的递归自我改进（RSI）早期迹象：一个由GLM-5.3驱动的Infra Agent帮助GLM-5.3-Flash在国产芯片上优化部署，两周内端到端吞吐量提升至3.2倍。

title.en: Are you sure? Finding the optimal model size is tricky: data volume, active parameter count, the number of environments, and the target inference cost. Model pe
title.zh: Are you sure? Finding the optimal model size is tricky: data volume, active parameter count, the number of environments, and the target inference cost. Model pe

note.en: Tang Jie argues optimal model size is hard to pin down, shaped jointly by data volume, active parameter count, number of environments and target inference cost rather than any single factor.
note.zh: 唐杰认为最优模型规模难以简单确定，需综合数据量、激活参数量、环境数量和目标推理成本等因素，而非单一指标决定。

title.en: Updated AA index... Now Fable 5.1 and GPT-astra have the same... https://t.co/G6cSEmAMus
title.zh: Updated AA index... Now Fable 5.1 and GPT-astra have the same... https://t.co/G6cSEmAMus

note.en: Tang shared an updated Artificial Analysis model index showing Fable 5.1 and GPT-astra now scoring the same.
note.zh: 唐杰分享了更新后的Artificial Analysis模型排行榜，显示Fable 5.1与GPT-astra目前得分相同。

title.en: add oil. The best time to try GLM-5.3 Flash https://t.co/d8HJM3jkqw
title.zh: add oil. The best time to try GLM-5.3 Flash https://t.co/d8HJM3jkqw

note.en: Encouraged users to try the newly launched GLM-5.3 Flash model.
note.zh: 鼓励用户尝试新发布的GLM-5.3 Flash模型。

title.en: Trace as State: Reasoning Traces as Conditional States for Long-Context Transformers
title.zh: Trace as State: Reasoning Traces as Conditional States for Long-Context Transformers

note.en: Tang Jie co-authored 'Trace as State,' proposing that placing reasoning traces before long-context input improves transformer reasoning, tested on GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek.
note.zh: 唐杰合著论文《Trace as State》，提出将推理轨迹置于长上下文之前可提升Transformer推理效果，并在GLM-5.2和DeepSeek上验证。

title.en: 小进展 📊我们的 Ox Alpha（对外名字：GLM-5.3 Flash）这周在 OpenRouter 的周 token 份额冲到了近 20%，排名第一几个数字值得一看：· AA 57，成绩单拿得出手...
title.zh: 小进展 📊我们的 Ox Alpha（对外名字：GLM-5.3 Flash）这周在 OpenRouter 的周 token 份额冲到了近 20%，排名第一几个数字值得一看：· AA 57，成绩单拿得出手...

note.en: He reports that GLM-5.3 Flash reached nearly 20% of OpenRouter's weekly token share, and that the model was served entirely on tens of thousands of domestic chips.
note.zh: 他发文称 GLM-5.3 Flash 的 OpenRouter 周 token 份额已接近 20%，并说明该模型全量部署在数万张国产芯片上。

title.en: Ox Alpha = GLM-5.3 Flash AA = 57 , 1/100 frontier price, Powered by pure Chinese chips. Delivered nearly 20% weekly token share (no. 1) on OpenRouter. Thanks to
title.zh: Ox Alpha = GLM-5.3 Flash AA = 57 , 1/100 frontier price, Powered by pure Chinese chips. Delivered nearly 20% weekly token share (no. 1) on OpenRouter. Thanks to

note.en: Tang Jie reported GLM-5.3 Flash's Artificial Analysis Index score of 57 at roughly 1/100th frontier-model price, running on domestic Chinese chips and topping OpenRouter's weekly token share.
note.zh: 唐杰公布GLM-5.3 Flash在Artificial Analysis指数上得分57，价格约为前沿模型的1/100，运行于国产芯片，并在OpenRouter周token份额上位居第一。

title.en: AWM: Answerable Working Memory for Long-Document VQA Agents
title.zh: AWM: Answerable Working Memory for Long-Document VQA Agents

note.en: Gives long-document VQA agents a working memory that records only what is actually answerable, cutting the noise carried across retrieved pages.
note.zh: 为长文档视觉问答智能体设计只记录真正可作答内容的工作记忆，减少检索页面之间传递的噪声。

title.en: cool comment: FLOPs were intelligence; parameters were knowledge!
title.zh: cool comment: FLOPs were intelligence; parameters were knowledge!

note.en: Tang Jie endorsed a framing distinguishing compute (FLOPs) as the driver of intelligence from parameter count as stored knowledge.
note.zh: 唐杰赞同一种观点，即算力（FLOPs）驱动智能，而参数量代表的是存储的知识。

title.en: Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how many parameters? It isn't a question th
title.zh: Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how many parameters? It isn't a question th

note.en: Tang Jie argued that scaling laws for LLMs are no longer just about parameter count, as every new model release raises the question of what else should scale.
note.zh: 唐杰指出，大模型的缩放定律不再只关乎参数量，每次新模型发布都引出还应扩展什么的问题。

title.en: Artificial Analysis Index = 60
title.zh: Artificial Analysis Index = 60

note.en: Tang Jie reported a GLM model scoring 60 on the Artificial Analysis Index benchmark.
note.zh: 唐杰公布一款GLM模型在Artificial Analysis指数评测中获得60分。

title.en: GLM-5.3 is coming. focusing on coding.
title.zh: GLM-5.3 is coming. focusing on coding.

note.en: Tang Jie announced the upcoming GLM-5.3 release, with coding as its focus.
note.zh: 唐杰宣布即将发布GLM-5.3，重点聚焦编程能力。

title.en: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling
title.zh: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling

note.en: Scheduling work from his Tsinghua/Zhipu group that raises the goodput of multi-turn agentic RL training by dispatching rollouts according to whether they are ready to resume.
note.zh: 他在清华／智谱团队的调度工作：按 rollout 是否就绪来分派任务，提升多轮智能体强化学习训练的有效吞吐。

title.en: 1M users already
title.zh: 1M users already

note.en: Tang Jie announced GLM had already reached 1 million users.
note.zh: 唐杰宣布GLM用户数已突破100万。

title.en: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators
title.zh: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators

note.en: A benchmark that checks whether automatic evaluators of machine-written surveys agree with human reviewers, written with his AMiner collaborators Fanjin Zhang and Juanzi Li.
note.zh: 与 AMiner 合作者张凡进、李涓子等合著的基准，检验自动综述评估器是否与人类审稿人判断一致。

title.en: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
title.zh: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift

note.en: Extends conformal prediction to large language models so that the coverage guarantee survives a change of decoding configuration.
note.zh: 将保形预测扩展到大语言模型，使覆盖率保证在解码配置改变后依然成立。

title.en: Memory for Large Language Models
title.zh: Memory for Large Language Models

note.en: A survey treating memory as an explicit architectural dimension of large language models rather than a byproduct of computation.
note.zh: 一篇综述，把记忆视为大模型显式的架构维度，而非计算的副产品。

title.en: 团队之前的这篇文章IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse 发表在大模型的一个国际会议 COLM，只改了几行代码就能实现：DSA ...
title.zh: 团队之前的这篇文章IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse 发表在大模型的一个国际会议 COLM，只改了几行代码就能实现：DSA ...

note.en: He explains his team's IndexCache paper, accepted at COLM, which removes the per-layer indexer cost of sparse attention by reusing indices across adjacent layers.
note.zh: 他介绍团队被 COLM 接收的 IndexCache 论文：通过跨相邻层复用索引，消除稀疏注意力中逐层重算 indexer 的开销。

title.en: Our Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO), is able to train stably for one thousand steps and consistently outperform GRPO and its variants on agentic
title.zh: Our Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO), is able to train stably for one thousand steps and consistently outperform GRPO and its variants on agentic

note.en: Tang Jie introduced Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO), a training method that trains stably for a thousand steps and outperforms GRPO variants on agentic coding and reasoning benchmarks.
note.zh: 唐杰介绍了单次异步优化（SAO）训练方法，能稳定训练上千步，并在智能体编程与推理基准上超越GRPO及其变体。

title.en: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
title.zh: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL

note.en: Scales computer-use agents with verifiable synthetic tasks and online reinforcement learning; co-authored with Yuxiao Dong and the AutoGLM group.
note.zh: 用可验证的合成任务与在线强化学习扩展计算机操作智能体，与东昱晓及 AutoGLM 团队合著。

title.en: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Replaces the batch-interleaved synchronous RL pipeline for LLM post-training with single-rollout asynchronous optimisation.
note.zh: 用单 rollout 异步优化取代大模型后训练中批量交错的同步强化学习流程。

title.en: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
title.zh: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents

note.en: Trains long-horizon agents with reinforcement learning over compacted context, so trajectories are not cut off by the context window.
note.zh: 在压缩上下文之上做强化学习训练长程智能体，使交互轨迹不再被上下文窗口截断。

title.en: 分享一点最近的“再学习”：ai时代——认知 > 格局 > 技术 > 管理很多人认为一个企业的成功靠管理，很对，曾经很对，但ai时代可能变了，一切都变了，天天端到端...
title.zh: 分享一点最近的“再学习”：ai时代——认知 > 格局 > 技术 > 管理很多人认为一个企业的成功靠管理，很对，曾经很对，但ai时代可能变了，一切都变了，天天端到端...

note.en: An essay arguing that in the AI era a company is carried by cognition and vision ahead of technology and management, and that managers who do not go deep on the technology cannot manage at all.
note.zh: 一篇长文，主张 AI 时代企业靠的是认知与格局，其次才是技术和管理；不深入技术的管理者根本无从管起。

title.en: Any new features we must have in the next version of glm?
title.zh: Any new features we must have in the next version of glm?

note.en: Tang Jie asked the community what features GLM's next version must have, drawing an unusually large reply thread for his account.
note.zh: 唐杰在X上询问社区GLM下一版本必须具备哪些新功能，引发了他账号上罕见的大量回复。

title.en: 318 tps.....crazy..... how can you make this happen... we have to work harder even more...
title.zh: 318 tps.....crazy..... how can you make this happen... we have to work harder even more...

note.en: Tang Jie reacted to GLM reaching 318 tokens per second inference speed, calling on the team to keep pushing.
note.zh: 唐杰对GLM推理速度达到318 tokens/秒表示振奋，并鼓励团队继续努力。

title.en: 5.2 could be better with more RL ...
title.zh: 5.2 could be better with more RL ...

note.en: Tang Jie said GLM-5.2 could still improve with more reinforcement learning.
note.zh: 唐杰表示GLM-5.2若加入更多强化学习训练仍有提升空间。

title.en: （Claude、GPT、GLM）🥇GLM-5.2登顶Artificial Analysis开源第一，全球前三GLM-5.2 今日发布并开源，在多个第三方权威基准和竞技场上交出扎实的成绩单。📊 A...
title.zh: （Claude、GPT、GLM）🥇GLM-5.2登顶Artificial Analysis开源第一，全球前三GLM-5.2 今日发布并开源，在多个第三方权威基准和竞技场上交出扎实的成绩单。📊 A...

note.en: He announces that GLM-5.2 took first place among open models on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index and third globally.
note.zh: 他宣布 GLM-5.2 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上位列开源模型第一、全球第三。

title.en: （Claude、GPT、GLM） GLM-5.2 Tops Artificial Analysis as the #1 Open-Source Model, Ranking Top 3 Globally GLM-5.2 launched and went open-source today, delivering a
title.zh: （Claude、GPT、GLM） GLM-5.2 Tops Artificial Analysis as the #1 Open-Source Model, Ranking Top 3 Globally GLM-5.2 launched and went open-source today, delivering a

note.en: Tang Jie highlighted GLM-5.2 topping Artificial Analysis as the #1 open-source model and ranking top 3 globally at launch.
note.zh: 唐杰强调GLM-5.2发布时在Artificial Analysis评测中位列开源模型第一、全球前三。

title.en: Video2Code: Generating Interactive Webpages from UI Videos via Action-Aware Revisit
title.zh: Video2Code: Generating Interactive Webpages from UI Videos via Action-Aware Revisit

note.en: Generates interactive webpages from UI screen recordings by revisiting the actions that trigger state transitions; from his Tsinghua vision-language group.
note.zh: 通过回溯触发状态转移的操作，从界面录屏生成可交互网页，出自他在清华的视觉语言团队。

title.en: LongWebBench: Evaluating Structural and Functional Webpage Generation in Long-Horizon Settings
title.zh: LongWebBench: Evaluating Structural and Functional Webpage Generation in Long-Horizon Settings

note.en: A benchmark for webpage generation that tests long, multi-screen and functional pages instead of single static screenshots.
note.zh: 面向网页生成的基准，考察长篇、多屏且具备功能的页面，而非单张静态截图。

title.en: AISE-Bench: A Full-Cycle Curated Benchmark for Information Seeking on Academic Knowledge Graphs
title.zh: AISE-Bench: A Full-Cycle Curated Benchmark for Information Seeking on Academic Knowledge Graphs

note.en: A benchmark for tool-using agents that seek information over academic knowledge graphs — the AMiner problem he has worked on for years.
note.zh: 面向在学术知识图谱上检索信息的工具型智能体的基准，正是他多年深耕的 AMiner 问题。

title.en: GLM-5.2上线并开源：专注Coding与长任务从2025初开始，我们几乎投入全部力量开始攻关Coding，历时大半年，细扣每一个代码环境的优化，终于迎来我们的代码基座GLM...
title.zh: GLM-5.2上线并开源：专注Coding与长任务从2025初开始，我们几乎投入全部力量开始攻关Coding，历时大半年，细扣每一个代码环境的优化，终于迎来我们的代码基座GLM...

note.en: Release note for GLM-5.2, open-sourced and aimed at coding and long-horizon tasks, with his account of why the team spent most of a year on code environments.
note.zh: GLM-5.2 上线并开源的发布说明，聚焦编程与长程任务，并讲述团队为何用大半年时间打磨代码环境。

title.en: We're introducing GLM-5.2, our latest flagship model for long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GL
title.zh: We're introducing GLM-5.2, our latest flagship model for long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GL

note.en: Tang Jie announced GLM-5.2, a flagship model with a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over GLM-5.1.
note.zh: 唐杰发布旗舰模型GLM-5.2，在长程任务能力上较GLM-5.1有大幅提升。

title.en: 致开发者：GLM-5.2 全量开放，前沿智能属于所有人今天，一些前沿模型的突发禁用令人遗憾。在这样一个前沿模型因非技术原因被突然切断访问的时刻，我们更加坚信：...
title.zh: 致开发者：GLM-5.2 全量开放，前沿智能属于所有人今天，一些前沿模型的突发禁用令人遗憾。在这样一个前沿模型因非技术原因被突然切断访问的时刻，我们更加坚信：...

note.en: An open letter to developers making GLM-5.2 fully available, written in response to frontier models being cut off for non-technical reasons and arguing science should stay global.
note.zh: 一封致开发者的公开信，宣布 GLM-5.2 全量开放，回应前沿模型因非技术原因被切断访问，主张科学应当全球化。

title.en: GLM-5.2 is Fully Open, Frontier Intelligence Belongs to Everyone Today, the sudden restriction of certain frontier models is deeply regrettable. At a time when
title.zh: GLM-5.2 is Fully Open, Frontier Intelligence Belongs to Everyone Today, the sudden restriction of certain frontier models is deeply regrettable. At a time when

note.en: Tang Jie made GLM-5.2 fully open-source, criticizing the recent trend of frontier labs restricting model access and arguing frontier intelligence should belong to everyone.
note.zh: 唐杰宣布GLM-5.2完全开源，并批评近期前沿实验室限制模型开放的趋势，主张前沿智能应属于所有人。

title.en: SCAIL-2: Unifying Controlled Character Animation with End-to-End In-Context Conditioning
title.zh: SCAIL-2: Unifying Controlled Character Animation with End-to-End In-Context Conditioning

note.en: Unifies controlled character animation under end-to-end in-context conditioning, dropping the intermediate pose representations earlier methods relied on; from his Tsinghua video-generation line.
note.zh: 用端到端的上下文条件化统一可控角色动画，去掉以往方法依赖的中间姿态表示，出自他在清华的视频生成方向。

title.en: 唯有专注与坚持科学研究与科技创业，皆是一场漫长、孤独而又令人心澎湃的淬炼。它极像是一场对未知的“唤醒”——需要将最前沿的理论、最复杂的工程与最现实的场...
title.zh: 唯有专注与坚持科学研究与科技创业，皆是一场漫长、孤独而又令人心澎湃的淬炼。它极像是一场对未知的“唤醒”——需要将最前沿的理论、最复杂的工程与最现实的场...

note.en: A short reflection on focus and persistence as the only way through the empty stretches of frontier research and technology entrepreneurship.
note.zh: 一篇短文，谈专注与坚持是穿越前沿研究与科技创业无人区的唯一方法。

title.en: From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory
title.zh: From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory

note.en: Treats an agent's memory updates as a multi-turn decision problem and optimises them with reinforcement learning, so a frozen model keeps improving at test time.
note.zh: 把智能体的记忆更新建模为多轮决策问题并用强化学习优化，使冻结的模型在测试时仍能持续变强。

title.en: Cross-Source Reasoning-based Correction for Author Name Disambiguation
title.zh: Cross-Source Reasoning-based Correction for Author Name Disambiguation

note.en: Corrects author name disambiguation in academic search by reasoning across sources — the exact failure mode that makes name-based paper attribution unreliable.
note.zh: 通过跨源推理修正学术搜索中的作者同名消歧，正是使按姓名归属论文变得不可靠的那类错误。

title.en: SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs
title.zh: SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs

note.en: Schema-conditioned iterative reasoning that makes knowledge-graph RAG agents work on enterprise graphs rather than only on public benchmarks.
note.zh: 以模式为条件的迭代推理，让知识图谱 RAG 智能体在企业图谱上可用，而不只是在公开基准上有效。

title.en: 想招几个牛博士后，一起来探讨LLM在不同领域的深度建模（包括：数据、Harness等）和应用，有兴趣可以email我（我的主页上有）。
title.zh: 想招几个牛博士后，一起来探讨LLM在不同领域的深度建模（包括：数据、Harness等）和应用，有兴趣可以email我（我的主页上有）。

note.en: He is recruiting postdocs to work on deep modelling and applications of LLMs across domains, including data and harness work.
note.zh: 他公开招聘博士后，方向是大模型在不同领域的深度建模与应用，包括数据与 harness 相关工作。

title.en: RotMoLE: Enhancing Mixture of Low-Rank Experts through Rotational Gating Mechanism
title.zh: RotMoLE: Enhancing Mixture of Low-Rank Experts through Rotational Gating Mechanism

note.en: Adds a rotational gating mechanism to mixtures of low-rank experts so one model can absorb several specialised domains at once.

body.en: Tang Jie's Tsinghua team published research mapping out how large models form and retain memory.
body.zh: 唐杰在清华的团队发表研究，揭示大模型记忆机制的全貌。

title.en: 唐杰杨植麟师徒对决：Kimi K3炸榜 智谱蒸发3000亿
title.zh: 唐杰杨植麟师徒对决：Kimi K3炸榜 智谱蒸发3000亿

body.en: Coverage frames a rivalry between Tang Jie's Zhipu AI and former student Yang Zhilin's Moonshot AI, with Kimi K3's rise reported alongside a roughly ¥300bn drop in Zhipu's valuation.
body.zh: 报道将唐杰的智谱AI与其学生杨植麟创立的月之暗面相对比：Kimi K3登榜走红，而智谱估值据报蒸发约3000亿元。

title.en: 唐杰杨植麟师徒对决：Kimi K3炸榜 智谱蒸发3000亿
title.zh: 唐杰杨植麟师徒对决：Kimi K3炸榜 智谱蒸发3000亿

body.en: Zhipu, where Tang Jie is chief scientist, reportedly lost 300 billion yuan in market value as Moonshot's Kimi K3 (led by his former student Yang Zhilin) topped the charts.
body.zh: 唐杰担任首席科学家的智谱据报道市值蒸发3000亿元，其昔日学生杨植麟旗下月之暗面的Kimi K3登顶榜单。

title.en: 唐杰预告「GLM史诗级升级」！技术论文入选顶会COLM
title.zh: 唐杰预告「GLM史诗级升级」！技术论文入选顶会COLM

body.en: Tang Jie previewed an "epic-level" GLM upgrade, alongside a technical paper accepted at the top-tier COLM conference.
body.zh: 唐杰预告GLM将迎来"史诗级"升级，相关技术论文已入选顶级会议COLM。

title.en: 智谱创始人唐杰：前沿人工智能应保持开放
title.zh: 智谱创始人唐杰：前沿人工智能应保持开放

body.en: Zhipu AI founder Tang Jie said frontier AI should remain open, a public stance on the open-vs-closed debate in Chinese foundation models.
body.zh: 智谱AI创始人唐杰表示前沿人工智能应保持开放，就中国基础模型领域开放与闭源之争表明立场。

title.en: “巨浪已来”，智谱创始人唐杰内部信曝光，重磅计划公布
title.zh: “巨浪已来”，智谱创始人唐杰内部信曝光，重磅计划公布

body.en: An internal letter from Zhipu AI founder Tang Jie leaked, revealing a major strategic plan centered on a two-year push toward artificial superintelligence.
body.zh: 智谱AI创始人唐杰的一封内部信曝光，披露了以“两年死磕通用超级智能（ASI）”为核心的重磅战略计划。

title.en: “巨浪已来”，智谱创始人唐杰内部信曝光，重磅计划公布
title.zh: “巨浪已来”，智谱创始人唐杰内部信曝光，重磅计划公布

body.en: An internal letter from Z.ai (Zhipu) founder Tang Jie was made public, laying out a major strategic plan as he says the company rides an incoming wave.
body.zh: 智谱创始人唐杰的一封内部信曝光，公布了一项重磅战略计划，他称公司正迎来一波"巨浪"。

title.en: 智谱创始人唐杰内部信：未来两年，将战略性投入四大核心引擎
title.zh: 智谱创始人唐杰内部信：未来两年，将战略性投入四大核心引擎

body.en: In an internal letter, Zhipu AI founder Tang Jie lays out a strategic plan to invest in four core engines over the next two years.
body.zh: 智谱AI创始人唐杰在内部信中宣布，未来两年将战略性投入四大核心引擎。

title.en: “巨浪已来”，智谱创始人唐杰内部信曝光，重磅计划公布！
title.zh: “巨浪已来”，智谱创始人唐杰内部信曝光，重磅计划公布！

body.en: An internal letter from Zhipu AI founder Tang Jie leaked, announcing a major new strategic plan he called "the giant wave has arrived."
body.zh: 智谱AI创始人唐杰的内部信曝光，宣布了他称为“巨浪已来”的重磅战略计划。

title.en: 智谱创始人唐杰发内部信，透露下一步战略方向
title.zh: 智谱创始人唐杰发内部信，透露下一步战略方向

body.en: Tang, as Zhipu's founder, sent an internal letter to staff outlining the company's next strategic direction.
body.zh: 唐杰作为智谱创始人向员工发出内部信，阐述公司下一步的战略方向。

title.en: 智谱创始人唐杰：巨浪已来，智能的上界正在被改写
title.zh: 智谱创始人唐杰：巨浪已来，智能的上界正在被改写

body.en: Zhipu founder Tang Jie argued that a wave of change has arrived and that the ceiling of machine intelligence is being rewritten.
body.zh: 智谱创始人唐杰表示，变革的巨浪已经到来，智能的上界正在被重新改写。

title.en: 晚点独家｜唐杰内部信称将开启 Touch High（摸高）计划，“不登顶，就是失败”
title.zh: 晚点独家｜唐杰内部信称将开启 Touch High（摸高）计划，“不登顶，就是失败”

body.en: In an internal letter, Tang Jie launched Zhipu's "Touch High" initiative, declaring that anything short of reaching the top counts as failure.
body.zh: 唐杰在内部信中宣布启动智谱的"摸高"计划，称"不登顶，就是失败"。

title.en: 智谱市值破万亿！创始人唐杰呛声马斯克
title.zh: 智谱市值破万亿！创始人唐杰呛声马斯克

body.en: Zhipu AI's market cap passed one trillion yuan, and founder Tang Jie publicly pushed back on Elon Musk's comments about the company.
body.zh: 智谱AI市值突破万亿元，创始人唐杰公开回应马斯克对公司的相关言论。

title.en: 马斯克说明年Q1，唐杰说用不了那么久，谁在闷头做中国的Mythos？
title.zh: 马斯克说明年Q1，唐杰说用不了那么久，谁在闷头做中国的Mythos？

body.en: Tang Jie said China's answer to a 'Mythos'-style AI system would arrive sooner than Musk's own next-year-Q1 timeline, a public stance on the pace of domestic AI progress.
body.zh: 唐杰表示中国版'Mythos'式AI系统的问世时间将早于马斯克所说的明年第一季度，就国内AI发展速度发表了公开看法。

title.en: 中国大模型何时能达Fable级别？马斯克预计明年Q1 唐杰称不用那么久
title.zh: 中国大模型何时能达Fable级别？马斯克预计明年Q1 唐杰称不用那么久

body.en: Asked when Chinese large models will reach GPT-5-class ("Fable") capability, Tang Jie said it would happen sooner than Musk's next-Q1 estimate.
body.zh: 被问及中国大模型何时能达到Fable（GPT-5）级别时，唐杰表示比马斯克预计的明年第一季度还要更快。

title.en: 唐杰深夜发文，AI从工具到劳动力只差这一步
title.zh: 唐杰深夜发文，AI从工具到劳动力只差这一步

body.en: Tang posted late at night arguing AI is one step away from moving from being a tool to becoming labor itself.
body.zh: 唐杰深夜发文称，AI距离从工具变为劳动力只差最后一步。

title.en: 姚顺雨、唐杰、林俊旸、杨强同台发声：中国大模型集体迈向“做事时代”
title.zh: 姚顺雨、唐杰、林俊旸、杨强同台发声：中国大模型集体迈向“做事时代”

body.en: Tang Jie joined Yao Shunyu, Junyang Lin and Yang Qiang on stage at the AGI-Next Summit, a rare joint appearance by leaders of China's major foundation-model efforts, arguing the field is shifting from chat to agents that get things done.
body.zh: 唐杰与姚顺雨、林俊旸、杨强同台出席AGI-Next峰会，这是中国主要大模型团队负责人罕见的集体亮相，共同提出行业正从对话式模型转向真正能做事的智能体。
